name: Anantara Plaza Nice
positioning: Anantara Plaza Nice Hotel: a Belle Epoque building from 1848 facing the Mediterranean, near Place Massena in central Nice
best_for: Travelers who want to explore Nice on foot, from the Promenade des Anglais to the old city
Guests who want a room with a balcony or terrace and garden or sea views

facts.text: The hotel is in a historic building with a Belle Epoque facade inaugurated in 1848.
The hotel faces the Mediterranean Sea and is near Place Massena, the main square in Nice.
Place Massena and the Promenade des Anglais are easy to reach on foot.
The hotel is next to the old city and many luxury boutiques.
The suites and rooms face the Mediterranean and the Albert 1er gardens.
Most rooms have either a garden or a sea view.
The majority of rooms have either a balcony or a terrace.
Rooms are inspired by the Mediterranean and the golden era of the Cote d'Azur.
Suites range from Junior to Presidential and add lounge or dining areas.
The gym is open 24 hours a day.
The SEEN by Olivier Rooftop Bar has both a restaurant and a bar area.
Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2023, 2025 and 2026.

highlights.text: Rooms on higher floors with a private terrace offer a panorama of the Baie des Anges.
Guests have access to the hotel's partner beach, Ruhl Plage.
The SEEN by Olivier Rooftop Bar offers panoramic views.
Hotel experiences include a visit and tasting at Chateau de Cremat.

considerations.text: There is no private parking; the hotel offers valet service to a secured public car park at extra cost.
The beach is a partner beach, Ruhl Plage, rather than the hotel's own.
WhataHotel notes an urban setting with city noise from a busy square.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Anantara Plaza Nice Hotel
